message: Hi Alex, it's Luis at Summit Heating, ok. Can you guarantee this gets me 30 more customers a month? I need a promise.
reply: Hi Luis, honest answer: no, I can't promise a number — anyone who does is guessing. What I can do is fix the issues actually hurting your site (speed, broken forms, mobile, etc.) for $900 flat, which tends to help conversions, not invent new traffic. No guarantees, just real fixes. Happy to send what I found if useful.
